name: Payment Systems
description: A payment system including NuGet library components for POS payment processing and a Web API for webhook-based payment reconciliation.
bullets: Design and develop NuGet library components for seamless integration with POS systems for payment processing
Implement robust Web APIs for webhook-based payment reconciliation to ensure transaction accuracy
Focus on implementing scalable design patterns to enable easy integration with multiple payment providers

name: Elevator Technical Specification Platform
description: An application to capture elevator technical specifications that assist construction planning and on-site maintenance for elevators and escalators.
bullets: Developed and maintained RESTful Web APIs using ASP.NET Core for elevator specification management
Built responsive UI components using Angular for technical data entry and review
Integrated the application with MS SQL Server for structured data storage and retrieval
Hosted and managed deployments via Azure App Service for production and test environments

name: Airline Management – Onboard Meal & Catering System
description: An internal application to manage onboard meals and catering services for airline commercial operations.
bullets: Owned end-to-end development of features, including requirement gathering, development, and delivery
Built and maintained RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL as the data store
Developed dynamic and responsive front-end modules using Angular
Investigated and resolved bugs across frontend and backend components to ensure stable performance

name: VoIP Service
description: An application for telecom commercial operations focused on provisioning and maintaining VoIP service orders and license management.
bullets: Developed and maintained Web APIs and MVC components using ASP.NET and SQL Server
Consumed and integrated external web services from telecom providers to support license provisioning workflows
Deployed services to testing environments and supported functional validation

name: Remote Location Intelligence
description: A product to automate the collection of site-specific data to analyze large volumes of information in the context of an address, enabling holistic planning, risk prediction, and mitigation.
bullets: Developed and maintained backend services using ASP.NET Core Web API to support data ingestion and processing
Integrated ArcGIS for geospatial data mapping and analysis at the site/address level
Worked with PostgreSQL for data storage and querying large spatial datasets
